activity_contract.active: canonical daily row exists and volume > 0
activity_contract.inactive: canonical daily row exists, volume == 0, and available H/L/C values are flat
activity_contract.uncertain_zero_volume: canonical daily row exists, volume == 0, but available H/L/C values are not flat
activity_contract.uncertain_missing_volume: canonical daily row exists but volume is missing/non-finite

diagnostic_reference.use: contextual comparison to the frozen pilot coverage gate only; never retroactively changes the frozen admission verdict
diagnostic_reference.strong_support_rule: activity-aware coverage >= 90% overall and in every year, with conservative lower bound >= 90% overall and every year
diagnostic_reference.inconclusive_rule: point activity-aware coverage passes but conservative lower bound fails because uncertain missing sessions could be active
diagnostic_reference.does_not_explain_rule: point activity-aware coverage remains below 90% overall or in any year
